$comment: Portal navigation sections for the 'public' audience. Order here is the order Scalar renders them. A tag's section comes from the x-domain extension its owning service emits; every surface now does, so there is no tagDomains fallback here. A tag the composer cannot place from x-domain is a hard failure -- add x-domain in the owning service rather than reintroducing a fallback, or the section a tag belongs to stops being owned by the team that owns the routes. tagDescriptions is a LEGACY-API-ONLY EXCEPTION (PLA-1531): legacy-api is frozen, so its three Practice tags get their portal intro text here. It only fills a tag the service left undescribed, so a service-provided description always wins. Every other service declares its tag descriptions in code; do not add their tags here.

tagDescriptions.Practice info: The practice's own profile: name, address and contact details. There is one per practice.
tagDescriptions.Offices: The practice's offices. Each location can belong to an office.
tagDescriptions.Locations: The places where the practice sees patients and keeps stock. Other resources refer to them by `locationId`.
